product_overview: A political campaign website for Deborah Dietzmann that lets visitors learn about the campaign, submit volunteer interest, and RSVP to events. It also includes a private admin dashboard for managing events, volunteer signups, and audit logs.
core_goals: Learn about the campaign from the public landing page
Submit a volunteer signup with contact details and helping preferences
Log in to the private admin dashboard
View audit history of changes made in the dashboard

features.name: Public Landing Page
features.description: Visitors can read campaign information and submit volunteer or RSVP forms from the public site.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through campaign information -> Fill out the volunteer form -> Submit the volunteer form -> See the form submission complete
Navigate to / -> Scroll through campaign information -> Fill out the RSVP form -> Submit the RSVP form -> See the RSVP submission complete

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Admins can sign in to access the protected dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See admin dashboard

features.name: Password Setup
features.description: Invited admins can set an initial password through the password update flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/update-password -> Set a new password -> Confirm the new password -> Submit password update -> See confirmation that the password has been set

features.name: Events Management
features.description: Authenticated admins can view, create, edit, and track campaign events.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/events -> View upcoming and past events -> Create a new event -> Enter event details -> Save the event -> See the new event appear in the list
Navigate to /admin/events -> View upcoming and past events -> Choose an upcoming event -> Update event details -> Save changes -> See the event details updated
Navigate to /admin/events -> View past events -> Select a past event -> Mark attendance -> Save attendance -> See attendance recorded
Navigate to /admin/events -> View upcoming and past events -> Review RSVP counts for events -> See how many RSVPs each event has

features.name: Volunteer Management
features.description: Authenticated admins can review volunteer signups and update their status.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/volunteers -> View list of volunteers -> Filter volunteers by status -> See the volunteer list update
Navigate to /admin/volunteers -> View list of volunteers -> Select a volunteer record -> Change status from pending to contacted -> See the updated status in the table

features.name: Audit Logs
features.description: Authenticated admins can review a chronological history of changes made in the admin area.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/logs -> View chronological audit entries -> Review the admin email associated with each change -> See the history of updates to events and volunteers
